description: This file defines a ViewModel class for managing categories in the Notes Android application, including search functionality and data transformation for UI display.

classes.name: CategoryViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that manages category data for the notes app, including search term handling and providing category navigation items.

methods.name: CategoryViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with application context and the notes repository.

methods.name: postSearchTerm
methods.description: Posts a new search term value to trigger category search updates.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of CategoryNavigationItem based on the current search term and account ID.
